observations.scope: The actual Cuba body at the URL labelled sixth-review national report is the2017 first national report under the Joint Convention on spent-fuel/radioactive-waste management; it is not a2014 CNS-sixth report. It describes halted Juragua construction in1992. TECDOC1110 Annex5 separately identifies two WWER-440/V-318 units, incomplete construction and asset preservation. Neither document assigns a generating operator to the two original cancelled units. CNSN is a regulator, and radioactive-waste operating licences are not Juragua generating licences.

Site/geological research and cited institutional names do not select a reactor class or designate an operating organisation for the two original cancelled Shivta unit proposals. The official GSI report and another publisher abstract refused access, so cached snippets supply no admitted body facts. Do not infer IEC operation, SMR size or PWR/BWR from research participation.

observations.scope: NuPEA’s January2023 draft SESA evaluates coastal and Lake Victoria basin candidate areas, including Tana River and Siaya, and programme technology selection. Its institutional table describes KenGen as a potential owner/operator of the national nuclear-power programme. That is a potential national role, not an approved designation or licence for the original Siaya proposal or four numbered Tana River units. Neither the programme agency nor consultant is a power-unit operator, and no particular reactor technology is selected for these original target cells.

Preserve historic lineage and present decommissioning responsibility as separate roles; neither is blindly promoted to original generating operator. All original common GEM coordinates/retired statuses/owners/types remain unchanged.

observations.scope: NSSC report distinguishes construction-permit and operation-licence submissions and describes current KHNP activities. These inspected clauses do not identify the original cancelled Daejin nuclear power plant unit1 operating organisation. A current-company chart or neighbouring active-plant company cannot supply that historical field. Some native text/font extraction is incomplete; retain original PDF and do not infer target-name absence from extraction alone. Exact historical unit-role admission remains pending.

citations.locator: September2025 report; PDF112 construction-versus-operation licence requirements; PDF29 KHNP programme; nativePDF retained and PDF14 visual-rendering checked

observations.scope: Readable government releases identify KHNP as Daejin project party, its2018 termination decision and2019 planned-site withdrawal. The2015 programme distinguishes Daejin1/2 construction intentions from alternative Cheonji3/4 proposals. These are developer/site-planning roles, not issued unit operating licences or explicit generating-operator designations. Original cancelled units and known physical class remain unchanged; later existing KHNP fleet roles are not copied.

Existing Wolsong CANDU3/4 and Shin-Wolsong1/2 are separate identities.

General technology-partnership rights do not explicitly designate the operating organisation of each numbered original unit or demonstrate an issued operating licence. Standard Power is the data-centre infrastructure customer and NuScale the technology supplier. The original shelved status is preserved; the historical 2029 forecast is not a commissioning event.
